description: This is a PHP class file that implements a power trend line for regression analysis within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It extends a base class 'BestFit' and provides methods for calculating the Y-value from an X-value, the X-value from a Y-value, the equation of the trend line, the intersection point, and performing power regression fitting.

classes.name: PowerBestFit
classes.description: A class that implements power-based regression analysis, providing methods for calculating the best fit curve based on power functions.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y-value for a given X-value using the power trend line equation.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X-value for a given Y-value using the power trend line equation.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns the algebraic equation of the power trend line as a string.

methods.name: getIntersect
methods.description: Calculates the intersection point where the trend line crosses Y=0.

methods.name: powerRegression
methods.description: Performs the power regression fitting and calculates goodness of fit.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regression with data points and performs the regression unless there is an error.
